subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-07-27
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/compare/funnel-vs-arlo (new)New comparison page closing the last gap in the comparison hub — Funnel.io is the one named competitor (marketing data hub / ETL to BI + warehouse, DA 89) that didn't have a dedicated page yet. Differentiated from the existing Windsor.ai/Supermetrics pages on Funnel's actual distinguishing traits: it normalizes data for a downstream BI tool (Looker Studio/Tableau/Power BI) you still have to build a report in, and it doesn't publish self-serve pricing (quote-only) vs. ARLO's free-to-start-today positioning. Auto-appears on /compare and in the sitemap (no template changes needed)."funnel.io" (170/mo, KD 17, re-verified live via SE Ranking) + "funnel io pricing" (90/mo, KD 23 — high-intent, since Funnel doesn't publish pricing)askarlo.app/compare/funnel-vs-arlo
/compare/agencyanalytics-vs-arlo, /compare/whatagraph-vs-arlo (fix)Both pages still advertised ARLO's own price as a "$0 Free / $19 Solo / $99 Studio" tier structure that no longer exists — the Jul 18 early-access change made everything free with no paid tiers, and the live /pricing page + /compare hub already reflect that. Two live pages were advertising a tier a prospect can't actually buy; corrected the table row and FAQ answer on both to "Free during early access — no card."accuracy fix, not keyword-targetedagencyanalytics-vs-arlo / whatagraph-vs-arlo

Needs your attention (unchanged, now 4 sessions old): the Jul 18 product commit wired real OAuth for 9 new connectors (Meta Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Clarity, GTM), but src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts — the file driving public status claims — still marks most of them coming_soon/waitlist, and Meta Ads' own "May 2026" eta is now 2+ months past due in the catalog copy itself. Still no Meta Ads MCP page (or the other 8) without your call on which are actually ready for agencies today.

Next: the comparison hub is now fully caught up to every named competitor in the original audit — next content push shifts to 2 more blog posts (a GA4-specific setup walkthrough and/or an agency-owner churn-risk piece). Static-rendering the marketing pages remains open and deferred to its own session (8th time flagged). GSC submission and an SE Ranking rank-tracking project for askarlo.app both still need human access. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
